title: Invite friends
lede: Send a friend your sign-up link. Once they sign up and accept a first delivery from Cheese, you both get credits.

code.label: Invite code
code.unlockHint: Accept your first delivery to add {n} more seats

steps.title: What your friend and you get
steps.signUp: Your friend signs up with your link
steps.accept: Within 7 days they accept a first delivery from Cheese
steps.meaning: A first acceptance means your friend actually got something done with it.

people.title: People you invited
people.capNote: Invitations earn at most 1,500 credits a month; once you reach it, friends who accept their first delivery that month earn you nothing more. Credits last 365 days from when they are paid and are used after the month's plan credits.
